newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Morgan completes buy of US$900 mln mortgages.
newsitem.headline: Morgan completes buy of US$900 mln mortgages.

text.p: Morgan Stanley Mortgage Capital Inc, a unit of U.S. investment bank Morgan Stanley Group Inc, said on Monday it had completed the purchase of about US$900 million of performing commercial mortgages from Teachers Insurance and Annuity (TIAA).
The terms of the sale were not disclosed by the companies in a joint statement released in several Asian centres, including Sydney.

TIAA said the pool of mortgages sold comprised more than 40 loans, of which $600 million were seasoned and performing restructured loans, while another $300 million represented performing loans on regional shopping centres.
Morgan Stanley said it intended to securitise most of the portfolio through an offering of commercial mortgage-backed securities.
TIAA is part of TIAA-CREF Investment Management Inc, a U.S. institional investor.
